literature_notes: All four ledger lines (L1–L4) describe C-terminal tags (Venus-Myc-SBP, myc-His, His6) appended after residue 314 of CALHM4. The authoritative topology places residues 203–314 in the intracellular compartment, so every cited tag faces the cytoplasm. The two extracellular spans (ECL1: 31–48, ECL2: 125–186) and the intracellular N-terminus (1–14) have no ledger support for any insertion whatsoever. No ledger line describes an extracellular tag, a tag in an extracellular loop, a fluorescent-protein fusion at an extracellular junction, or any transposon/domain-insertion screen for CALHM4 or a close ortholog. Per the rules, zero qualifying sites is the correct answer.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal Venus-Myc-SBP tag appended after residue 314, which lies in the intracellular C-terminal domain (203–314); confirmed functional for purification and detection but faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
